pull: A magical well of starlight swirling and whooshing upward, rising shimmer and a deep mystical hum

hit: A fantasy sword slash impact on armour, quick and punchy

shield: A crystal magic barrier forming, a resonant glassy hum
burn: A burst of magical fire igniting, a crackling whoosh

rise: A soul rising again: an angelic swell and bright chime

dust: Glittering stardust coins tinkling into a crystal bowl
